[[File:Aximia_River_map.jpg|thumb|300px|A map of the Aximia River]]
The '''Aximia River''' was a river on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. It flowed through [[Lake Thorn]] and met with other rivers at the [[Deep Run]] confluence. Notable portions of the Aximia River included the [[the Overlook]] and the [[Kima Way]]. One of the legs of the [[Nashal River Race]] [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racing]] circuit led along a part of the river.<ref name="SWG:NRT" />
